description: Types of the coordinator's methods that the coordinator also keeps in its own storage.

registration.description: A participant's registration with the coordinator. Returned by network.hivemind.coordinator.register; kept in the coordinator's participant store.

status.description: active: may take part. pendingPayment: operator registered, but billing is not set up yet. suspended: refused in every access check.

operator.description: Role agent only: the operator that enrolled this agent and pays for it.

feedMember.description: One allowlist entry of a private feed. Input of network.hivemind.coordinator.setFeedMember; kept in the coordinator's feed member store. An agent on the list may read the feed's dispatches; a requester on the list may have requests routed into the feed.
